evidence: No tool lists the 3D-ΔPDF's strongest features with their vectors and signs, which the task and delta-pdf-interpretation step 3 ask for: dpdf_contrast reports the strongest feature in σ without its place, measure_dpdf_cut an SNR and an anisotropy, and line_profile reads a line the model must already have chosen.
proposed_fix: A dpdf_peaks tool: the extrema of the ΔPDF above a few robust σ outside the origin's disk, each with its vector in Å and r.l.u., its sign and its size in σ, read from the 3D volume on the server.
note: dpdf_peaks, default 5σ and 12 entries. On the dev control the planted ⟨3/2 0 0⟩+ is entry 7 (238σ) and the weaker ⟨½ 1 1⟩− entry 19 (73σ): a model asks for up to 30.
